general.q: In darts, what is the highest score a player can checkout using just two darts?
general.why: A maximum two-dart finish requires a treble 20 (60) followed by the bullseye (50).

general.q: In which European capital city would you find the famous Spanish Steps?
general.why: Despite their name, the Spanish Steps climb from Piazza di Spagna in Rome.

general.q: Which British chemist invented the miner's safety lamp in 1815?
general.why: Sir Humphry Davy's wire mesh design allowed light through without igniting gases.

general.q: Which variety of bean is traditionally used in British tinned baked beans?
general.why: Manufacturers like Heinz use dried haricot beans, also known as navy beans.

general.q: Which English city was founded by the Romans under the name Eboracum?
general.why: Founded in 71 AD as a legionary fortress, Eboracum grew into Roman York.

pop.q: In the Channel 4 sitcom Spaced, what is the first name of the eccentric artist who lives downstairs?
pop.why: Brian Topp, played by Mark Heap, famously described his art style as "Angst, pain, aggression... clear?".

pop.q: In the 2004 video game Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas, what is the nickname of the main protagonist?
pop.why: Carl "CJ" Johnson returns home to Los Santos after his mother's murder in the classic 2004 game.

pop.q: Which iconic 1990s water gun brand was invented by former NASA engineer Lonnie Johnson?
pop.why: Lonnie Johnson developed the Super Soaker while working on heat pumps for the US Air Force and NASA.

pop.q: Which chocolate brand's 2007 TV advert featured a gorilla playing drums to a Phil Collins song?
pop.why: The viral Cadbury advert featured an actor in a gorilla suit playing along to 'In the Air Tonight'.

pop.q: In the 1994 film Pulp Fiction, what does Vincent Vega say a Quarter Pounder with Cheese is called in Paris?
pop.why: Vincent explains to Jules that because of the metric system, it's called a Royale with Cheese.

music.q: Which electronic act released the acclaimed UK Number 1 album 'The Fat of the Land' in 1997?
music.why: The album debuted at Number 1 in both the UK and US, featuring iconic singles like 'Firestarter'.

music.q: Which singer represented the UK at the 1996 Eurovision Song Contest with 'Ooh Aah... Just a Little Bit'?
music.why: Gina G finished eighth in Eurovision, but her track went on to top the UK Singles Chart.

music.q: Which film director directed the iconic 1983 music video for Michael Jackson's 'Thriller'?
music.why: John Landis directed the 14-minute short film after Jackson admired his work on An American Werewolf in London.

music.q: Which pop group achieved the UK Christmas Number 1 in 2002 with their debut single 'Sound of the Underground'?
music.why: Girls Aloud formed on Popstars: The Rivals and beat boyband rival One True Voice to the top spot.

music.q: Which musician was the lead guitarist and primary co-songwriter for Manchester band The Stone Roses?
music.why: John Squire co-wrote the band's hits with lead singer Ian Brown and also created their iconic artwork.

mix.q: In the Channel 4 sitcom Peep Show, what is the nickname of Jeremy's wild bandmate played by Matt King?
mix.why: Matt King played the iconic, drug-addled musician Super Hans across all nine series of Peep Show.

mix.q: Which British band had a UK number one hit in 1998 with Fatboy Slim's remix of 'Brimful of Asha'?
mix.why: Norman Cook (Fatboy Slim) remixed Cornershop's tribute to Indian music legend Asha Bhosle into a number one hit.

mix.q: In which English county is the cathedral city of Canterbury located?
mix.why: Canterbury Cathedral, located in Kent, is the mother church of the worldwide Anglican Communion.

mix.q: In the 1999 movie The Sixth Sense, which actor plays child psychologist Malcolm Crowe?
mix.why: Bruce Willis starred as Dr Malcolm Crowe alongside Haley Joel Osment in the smash-hit supernatural thriller.

mix.q: Which organ in the human body is responsible for producing bile to aid digestion?
mix.why: While bile is stored in the gallbladder, it is actually produced by the liver.

mix.q: Which British synth-pop band had a hit single in 1984 with 'Smalltown Boy'?
mix.why: Jimmy Somerville's distinctive falsetto lead vocals made 'Smalltown Boy' a huge synth-pop hit for Bronski Beat.

mix.q: Which British monarch was the last to belong to the House of Hanover?
mix.why: Queen Victoria was the final Hanoverian monarch before the royal house switched to Saxe-Coburg and Gotha.

mix.q: In the original 1996 video game Tomb Raider, in which country does Lara Croft begin her adventure?
mix.why: Lara Croft begins her quest for the Scion in the snowy mountain ruins of Vilcabamba, Peru.

mix.q: Which classic Italian cocktail is made with equal parts gin, sweet vermouth, and Campari?
mix.why: The Negroni was invented in Florence in 1919 when Count Camillo Negroni asked for gin in his Americano.

mix.q: In the hit American sitcom Friends, what is Chandler's embarrassing middle name?
mix.why: Chandler's middle name Muriel is revealed in season 10, to the great amusement of his friends.
